{"notes": "Visit 1 (ended 1:00): Team chose a fish quickly. Leo set direction and roles; Priya took the tail; Tom offered joint checks; Maya was assigned the belly but said nothing.

Visit 2 (ended 2:30): The picture shows one connected dark line from START (27.3, 4.1) down to about (22, 8.3), then up and left to about (8.6, 5.6). It is much longer than at 1:00 and appears to reach the head. There is no belly, tail fork or pale (disconnected) dominoes yet. I can't say who placed which domino, so I'm not crediting the line to anyone. It looks unbroken.

Leo: Said he had about a dozen left at 2:00 and asked Tom not to redo finished work. He also reminded Priya to start the fork from a line end so it stays attached. Good leadership and clarity. The line has now grown well past a dozen, but I can't confirm he laid it.

Tom: Said he'd jump on the top line round the head and offered to check joints. Leo had asked him to check joints only once the line reached the head, and Priya then told him to take the head. That overlaps a bit with Leo's request. I didn't see what he actually placed or tested. Verify.

Priya: Reported the tail end is connected and solid, which matches the picture. Set up a sensible plan to meet Maya in the middle on the belly and kept checking joints. Strong coordination, but no visible fork or tail yet, and her plan depends on Maya.

Maya: Still silent, twice now, and no belly is visible. Maybe blocked, maybe not started. No evidence either way, so I'm not rating her yet. Ask her privately at the next visit and check that she has what she needs.

Next visit: Check whether the belly has started, whether the fork and tail are attached, and who's doing the head and joint checks."}
